headline: I build software that real businesses run on every day.
about:
I'm a **full-stack developer** from Brazil who ships production systems end to end — from the database schema and the API to the UI, the deploy and the 3 a.m. monitoring alert.

Today I'm the developer behind **VFoster**, a multi-tenant restaurant SaaS live in production, and the **internal management platform of Conexão Web Telecom**, an internet provider whose teams use it every day for processes, inventory, service orders, fleet and customer referrals.

I started in tech in 2012 doing hands-on IT support, moved through QA and network operations, and now combine all of it: I write the code, understand the infrastructure it runs on and test it like someone who has been on call for it.
location: Mogi das Cruzes, São Paulo — Brazil

stats.label: modules in the ISP management system

highlights.title: Multi-tenant SaaS
highlights.text: **VFoster** gives each restaurant its own domain and **isolated PostgreSQL schema**, with orders, menu, QR-code tables, cash register, inventory and analytics. Integrated with **iFood, 99Food, Stripe and WhatsApp**, with background workers on **BullMQ/Redis**.

highlights.title: Internal platforms
highlights.text: A **Node.js + React + MySQL** system with 15+ modules used daily at an ISP — integrated with the **Hubsoft ERP** (REST and GraphQL), covered by automated tests and evolved through 70 versioned database migrations.

highlights.title: Mobile for field teams
highlights.text: A **React Native (Expo)** app that lets field technicians handle service orders on the go, talking to the same backend as the web platform.

highlights.title: Infra & automation
highlights.text: Monitoring with **Zabbix and Grafana**, network equipment (OLTs, MikroTik, **TR-069 / GenieACS**), Docker + Nginx deploys with **CI/CD on GitHub Actions**, and Python automations that remove manual work.
